items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Then Barney played with me a while with the Maple Leaf Band.

ctx.x: You and Barney? No. You haven't played together in a while.

Well, I'm the one who got Barney East Stark. Oh yeah? How did that work? Well, Barney wasn't playing with nobody. And I got him with a little band used to rehearse by the St. Bernard Market. Oh man Bernard Orchestra. And I got Barney in that little band. I'm the one who started him out. Then Barney played with me a while with the Maple Leaf Band. I'm the one who started him out.
Who was in Oh Man Bernard's orchestra?
